# Hussain Sultan

> > Personal website of Hussain Sultan, data analytics consultant specializing in Python, machine learning, and open-source data tools.

Hussain Sultan is a data analytics consultant at Full Spectrum Analytics with experience at organizations including Capital One, Voltron Data, Amazon, and the Department of Defense. His work focuses on Python-based data analytics, machine learning, and contributions to the open-source community including PyData DC.
